chunks: And Ibn Mahbub narrated from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Basir, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them:
Regarding a man who gave another man dirhams so that he might perform on his behalf a single Hajj: is it permissible for him to perform Tamattu' with the 'Umrah to the Hajj?
He said: Yes; he has only differed from him toward greater merit and goodness.

key_terms.بِٱلْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى ٱلْحَجِّ: the 'Umrah joined to the Hajj, indicating hajj al-tamattu'
key_terms.حَجَّةً مُفْرَدَةً: a single Hajj performed in the ifrad form
key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعَ: to perform tamattu', combining 'Umrah and Hajj in the prescribed manner

ai.seo_question: If someone is deputed to perform hajjah mufradah on another's behalf, may he perform hajj al-tamattu' instead?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about delegated hajj. It states that if a person was appointed and funded to perform a hajjah mufradah on behalf of another, it is permissible for him instead to perform tamattu', because this is a shift toward what is more meritorious and better.
